ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Gestlio needs access to your camera so you can photograph your accommodation and the result of a cleaning.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Gestlio needs access to your photos so you can add pictures of your accommodation and upload proof of a completed cleaning.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Gestlio does not use your location. This permission is never requested by the app.
